reason: The production overlay is reachable only when Taro.navigateTo rejects. Normal journeys cannot render this real fallback branch, so deterministic read-only failure injection is required for fresh evidence.
allowedMechanism: In the browser QA context only, temporarily intercept Taro.navigateTo or the resolved runtime navigation function for the targeted card-detail call and return a rejected Promise.
Trigger the unchanged real card action and observe the unchanged production catch/fallback path rendering DetailOverlay.
Restore the original function before leaving the test case.
forbidden: No production source, route, API, store, fixture data, or handler may be changed to expose the branch.
No external request or mutation may be emitted.
The harness may not synthesize overlay DOM or call internal overlay state setters directly.
Harness evidence may not be reused for the normal successful navigation branch.
requiredEvidence: all overlay states tested by pointer, Enter, and Space
